title: Izithunywa Zomusa Namandla
intro: Cabanga ntambama ethule ephazanyiswa ukufika kwabahambi ongabazi. Ukubukeka kwabo kuyinto evamile, kodwa injongo yabo ayifani nhlobo. Baphethe umyalezo waphezulu ozoshintsha indlela yezizwe ezimbili, ulethe uhleko ekhaya elingenalutho kanye nokwesaba emzini onesono. Bangobani laba zivakashi eziyimfihlakalo?
clues: Sathunyelwa encekwini ka-Allah ezinikele, eyaziwa ngokungenisa izihambi okungenamkhawulo.
Safika sisesimweni sabantu esingabazi, kodwa umninikhaya wethu wezwa okuthile okuhlukile ngokuba khona kwethu.
Silethe izindaba ezenza owesifazane osekhulile wahleka ngokungakholwa, ezishaya ubuso bakhe ngokumangala.
Sasinikwe umsebenzi wokuvikela umndeni olungile ngenkathi siletha inhlekelele edolobheni eligcwele inkohlakalo.
Senqaba ukudla esikunikezwe, okwakhulisa ukusola komnikazi wethu.
Saveza ubunjalo bethu bangempela ngaphambi kokuhamba, sithi, 'Ngempela, siyizithunywa zeNkosi yakho.'
